fields.title: Sponsored ad / search result record
fields.description: Three record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. SPONSORED_AD is a product carrying Amazon's Sponsored label on page one, with its slot position. ORGANIC is a non-sponsored result (only when requested). KEYWORD_SUMMARY rolls a keyword up across all samples: sponsored share, slot positions and the most persistent advertisers. Ad slots are auctioned per impression, so a keyword with zero ads is a real result rather than a failure. Every type is nullable accordingly.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword this row came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-search-page for a product row, S2-aggregate for a keyword summary, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this row was captured.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_INPUT, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, CAPTCHA_ESCALATION, EMPTY_RESULT). CAPTCHA_ESCALATION means Amazon challenged the request; this actor does not solve CAPTCHAs.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain suffix searched, e.g. com or co.uk.

sampleIndex.title: Sample index
sampleIndex.description: Which impression this row came from, 1-based. Ads are auctioned per impression, so the same keyword can return different advertisers across samples.

isSponsored.title: Sponsored
isSponsored.description: True when the result carried Amazon's Sponsored label inside its own result tile. Sponsored strings elsewhere on the page (feedback widgets, banners) are deliberately not counted.

position.title: Position
position.description: 1-based slot on page one. The key bidding-intelligence field: a competitor consistently holding position 1-4 is bidding hard.

slotBand.title: Slot band
slotBand.description: TOP (positions 1-4), MID (5-20) or LOWER. Set on sponsored rows only, reflecting Amazon's observed ad-block layout.

asin.title: ASIN
asin.description: Amazon product identifier of the advertised product.

title.title: Title
title.description: Product title as shown in the search result.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price as a number, parsed from Amazon's canonical price element. Forced into the selected marketplace's currency regardless of where the actor runs.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency symbol or code detected alongside the price. Always check this rather than assuming USD.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Number of ratings - useful for telling whether an advertiser is buying visibility for a new product.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Product thumbnail from the search result.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: Canonical Amazon product URL built from the ASIN.

isPrime.title: Prime
isPrime.description: Whether the result shows Prime eligibility.

samplesTaken.title: Samples taken
samplesTaken.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. How many impressions were sampled for this keyword.

totalResults.title: Total results
totalResults.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Results parsed across all samples.

sponsoredCount.title: Sponsored count
sponsoredCount.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Sponsored placements found across all samples. Zero is a legitimate result for a low-competition keyword.

organicCount.title: Organic count
organicCount.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Non-sponsored results across all samples.

sponsoredSharePercent.title: Sponsored share %
sponsoredSharePercent.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Percentage of page-one slots that were paid placements - how contested the keyword is. Measured range across sample keywords was 0% to 21.7%.

sponsoredPositions.title: Sponsored positions
sponsoredPositions.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Every slot position that carried an ad, across samples.

topSlotAdCount.title: Top-slot ads
topSlotAdCount.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Ads captured in positions 1-4, the most expensive real estate.

uniqueAdvertisedAsins.title: Unique advertisers
uniqueAdvertisedAsins.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. How many distinct products were advertised on this keyword.

mostPersistentAsins.title: Most persistent advertisers
mostPersistentAsins.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. ASINs ranked by how many samples they appeared in. An ASIN in every sample is bidding continuously, not just winning one auction - this is the core competitor signal.

avgAdPrice.title: Average ad price
avgAdPrice.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Mean price of advertised products - the price point competitors think is worth paying to promote.

avgAdRating.title: Average ad rating
avgAdRating.description: KEYWORD_SUMMARY. Mean star rating of advertised products.
